people.name: Cleto González Víquez
people.nameZh: 克萊托·岡薩雷斯·比克斯

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，岡薩雷斯·比克斯1858年10月13日生於巴爾瓦（Barba de Heredia），出身貴族家庭。該條目稱他是傑出的律師與政治人物，也是該國最出色的歷史學者之一；他在聖托馬斯大學修讀法律，並參與起草民法、刑法與司法法典的委員會。德國國家圖書館的權威檔也把他列為法學家、歷史學家與政治人物。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, González Víquez was born on 13 October 1858 in Barba de Heredia to an aristocratic family. The entry calls him an eminent attorney and distinguished politician and one of the most illustrious historians of his country; he studied law at the University of St. Thomas and took part in the commission that drew up the civil, penal and legal codes. The German National Library authority record likewise lists him as a jurist, historian and politician.

citations.quote: b. 13 October 1858
born in Barba de Heredia, Costa Rica, to an aristocratic family
He was an eminent attorney, distinguished politician
one of the most illustrious historians of his country
He studied law at the University of St. Thomas
He took part in the commission that drew up the civil, penal, and legal codes
Jurist, Historiker, Politiker

heading.zh-Hant: 議員、部長與第一任總統
heading.en: Congress, a ministry and the first presidency

body.zh-Hant: 同一條目稱他兩度出任全國國會議員、一度任政府部長（原文 minister of Government），主張自由主義原則並反對當時的改革運動。1906年，在其對手被逐出國境的爭議性選舉後，他當選哥斯大黎加總統，任職至1910年。總統府歷任名單同樣記載他1906年4月1日當選，任期列為1906至1910年。
body.en: The same entry says he served twice as a representative to the national Congress and once as minister of Government, defended liberal principles and opposed the reformist movements of the era. In 1906, after a controversial election in which his rivals were expelled from the country, he was elected president of Costa Rica and held the office until 1910. The presidency's list of former presidents likewise records his election on 1 April 1906 and lists the term as 1906–1910.

citations.quote: served twice as a representative to the national Congress
once as minister of Government
He defended liberal principles and opposed the reformist movements of the era
his rivals were expelled from the country

heading.zh-Hant: 反對派領袖與第二任總統

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱，他在1916至1917年領導國會反對總統阿爾弗雷多·岡薩雷斯·弗洛雷斯，並支持把弗洛雷斯趕下台的政變。1920年代他維持自由主義立場，在國家共和黨內仍有影響力。他1928年再度當選總統，並須面對1929年起的經濟危機衝擊；總統府名單載其1928年2月12日當選，任期列為1928至1932年。
body.en: The entry says that in Congress he led the opposition to President Alfredo González Flores in 1916–1917 and supported the coup d'état that drove Flores from power. In the 1920s he kept his liberal stance and remained influential in the National Republican Party. He was elected president again in 1928 and had to face the effects of the economic crisis that began in 1929; the presidency's list records his election on 12 February 1928 and gives the term as 1928–1932.

supported the coup d'état that drove Flores from power

He was again elected president in 1928

body.zh-Hant: 據《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》，卡洛斯·梅倫德斯生於1861年2月1日，屬薩爾瓦多自19世紀初起的地主寡頭家族。該家族原本生產靛藍，是最早大規模種植咖啡的家族之一。條目並稱，梅倫德斯家族在1913至1927年間連續三個任期出任總統，這十四年任期正是薩爾瓦多政治封閉、菁英化的明顯例子。
body.en: According to the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture, Carlos Meléndez was born on 1 February 1861 into a Salvadoran landowning oligarchy that dated from the early nineteenth century. The family had originally produced indigo and was among the first to grow coffee on a large scale. The entry adds that the Meléndez family held the presidency for three consecutive terms in 1913–1927, and that this fourteen-year occupancy is the clearest example of the restrictive, elitist nature of Salvadoran politics.

citations.quote: President Carlos Meléndez (b. 1 February 1861
part of the original Salvadoran landowning oligarchy
Originally producers of indigo
among the first to grow coffee on a large scale
held the presidency for three consecutive terms (1913–1927)
restrictive, elitist nature of Salvadoran politics
The Meléndez presidents' fourteen-year occupancy

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱梅倫德斯1913年在曼努埃爾·阿勞霍遇刺後就任總統。他曾多次前往美國，希望推動工業化，並把薩爾瓦多的農業經濟分散到劍麻和棉花。
body.en: The entry says Meléndez took office in 1913 following the assassination of Manuel Araujo. He had made many trips to the United States and wished to promote industrialization and to diversify El Salvador's agrarian economy into henequen and cotton.

citations.quote: took office in 1913 following the assassination of Manuel Araujo

heading.zh-Hant: 中立政策與梅倫德斯主義

body.zh-Hant: 條目指出，他任內最受矚目的兩項政策，一是在美國的強大壓力下仍讓薩爾瓦多在第一次世界大戰中保持中立，二是主張豐塞卡灣為共管水域，由此提出所謂「梅倫德斯主義」，質疑尼加拉瓜有權依1913年的布賴恩—查莫羅條約把海軍基地授予美國。1914年他把此案提交中美洲法院，並獲得有利判決。
body.en: The entry says his tenure is most notable for two policies: keeping El Salvador neutral in World War I despite heavy pressure from the United States, and his claim to the Gulf of Fonseca as a condominium territory. The latter produced the so-called Meléndez Doctrine, which challenged Nicaragua's right to grant the United States a naval base under the Bryan-Chamorro Treaty of 1913. In 1914 he took his case to the Central American Court of Justice and won a judgment in his favor.

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱梅倫德斯1918年因健康惡化，把總統職位交給弟弟豪爾赫。薩爾瓦多立法議會的法令另述，1918年7月15日的立法法令在「梅倫德斯先生政府任內」把瓜薩帕鎮升格為市。
body.en: The entry says Meléndez passed the presidency to his younger brother Jorge when his health failed in 1918. A decree of the Salvadoran Legislative Assembly adds that a legislative decree of 15 July 1918, issued during the administration of Don Carlos Meléndez, conferred the title of city on the town of Guazapa.

people.name: Agustín Pedro Justo
people.nameZh: 阿古斯丁·佩德羅·胡斯托

body.zh-Hant: 阿根廷國家檔案館的人物權威記錄稱，胡斯托1876年2月26日生於恩特雷里奧斯省的烏拉圭河畔康塞普西翁。他1892年自軍事學院畢業，屬炮兵；之後取得土木工程師資格，1904年的一項法令把這項資格認定為與軍事工程師相當。德國國家圖書館權威檔把他描述為阿根廷軍人、外交官與政治人物。
body.en: The Argentine National Archives authority record says Justo was born in Concepción del Uruguay, Entre Ríos province, on 26 February 1876. He graduated from the Colegio Militar in 1892 in the artillery arm and later obtained the title of civil engineer; a decree of 1904 treated this qualification as equivalent to that of military engineer. The German National Library authority record describes him as an Argentine soldier, diplomat and politician.

citations.quote: nació en Concepción del Uruguay, provincia de Entre Ríos
provincia de Entre Ríos, el 26 de febrero de 1876
Egresó del Colegio Militar en el año 1892 en el arma de artillería
obtuvo el título de Ingeniero Civil

body.zh-Hant: 檔案館記錄稱他教授數學，其中在軍事學院方面，1913年任副院長，1915至1922年任院長。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》同樣說他在1915至1922年擔任母校院長，並藉此影響了一整代軍官。
body.en: The archive record says he taught mathematics and that at the Colegio Militar he was vice-director in 1913 and director in 1915–1922. The Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture likewise says he was director of his alma mater in 1915–1922 and gained influence over a generation of military officers through it.

fue vicedirector en 1913 y director entre 1915 y 1922
as the director of his alma mater between 1915 and 1922

heading.en: Minister of War and the Peru mission

body.zh-Hant: 1922年總統阿爾維亞爾任命他為戰爭部長；總統府的阿爾維亞爾任期頁列出他在1922年10月12日至1928年10月12日任戰爭部長。檔案館稱他任內在最偏遠的地區興建營房，1923年被晉升為上校，1924年又被任命為駐秘魯特別使團大使，出席阿亞庫喬戰役百年慶典。
body.en: In 1922 President Alvear appointed him Minister of War, and the presidency's page for the Alvear term lists him as Minister of War from 12 October 1922 to 12 October 1928. The archive record says that in office he built barracks in the most remote regions of the country, that in 1923 he was promoted to colonel, and that in 1924 he was named ambassador on special mission to Peru for the centenary of the Battle of Ayacucho.

citations.quote: el presidente Alvear lo nombró Ministro de Guerra
Agustín Pedro Justo (12 de octubre de 1922-12 de octubre de 1928)
construyó cuarteles en las regiones más alejadas del país
En 1923 fue promovido al grado inmediato superio a Coronel
En 1924 fue nombrado Embajador en Misión Especial en el Perú
Centenario de la Batalla de Ayacucho

body.zh-Hant: 檔案館稱他參與了1930年由烏里武魯將軍領導、推翻伊里戈延的革命，之後經過兩年事實政權，他以民主國民黨、激進公民聯盟反個人主義派和獨立社會黨的支持，當選1932至1938年的總統。《百科》稱他在臨時政府中任陸軍總司令；1931年對烏里武魯的支持減弱後，臨時政府辦出有利保守派的選舉。檔案館記載他的總統任期自1932年2月20日起算。
body.en: The archive record says he took part in the Revolution of 1930, led by General Uriburu, which overthrew Hipólito Yrigoyen; after two years of de facto rule he was elected president for 1932–1938 by the Partido Demócrata Nacional, the Antipersonalist Radical Civic Union and the Partido Socialista Independiente. The Encyclopedia says he took part in the provisional government as commander-in-chief of the army, and that when support for Uriburu faded in 1931 the provisional government sponsored elections engineered to favor the conservatives. The archive record dates his presidency from 20 February 1932.

dirigida por el general José Félix Uriburu

fue elegido Presidente de la Nación para el período 1932-1938

body.zh-Hant: 檔案館稱他任內推動一套規範貨幣體系的機制，並由國家推動輕型半工業化；羅卡—倫西曼協定於1933年5月1日簽訂。《百科》說他帶領阿根廷度過大蕭條，並列出所得稅與中央銀行的創設，但也指出選舉舞弊、審查與鎮壓日益嚴重。他1938年2月20日任滿，把職位交給奧爾蒂斯與卡斯蒂略的組合，1943年1月11日去世。
body.en: The archive record says that in office he set in motion a set of mechanisms regulating the monetary system and promoted light semi-industrialisation from the state; the Roca-Runciman pact was signed on 1 May 1933. The Encyclopedia says his administration steered Argentina through the Great Depression and lists the national income tax and the creation of the Central Bank, but notes the growing reliance on electoral fraud, censorship and repression. His term ended on 20 February 1938, when he handed over to the Ortiz–Castillo ticket, and he died on 11 January 1943.

AGN 與百科只寫他獲民主國民黨、激進公民聯盟反個人主義派等支持當選，以及他加入反個人主義派；未寫黨內職務，故不建黨職候選。
總統府的 Justo 個人頁寫死亡日為 1876-02-26（與生日相同，明顯錯植），已不採用；其他來源（AGN）寫 1943-01-11。另有一份無署名百科條目（Encyclopedia of World Biography 類）因 Q9 只能當線索，未引用。
